events.text: Gate 1 is safe on the right. All robots take the right door.

Round 2: Gate 2 left is confirmed safe by multiple robots. A2 is inspecting gate 3, so I should not attempt gate 3 yet.
Round 3: A4 has confirmed gate 3 right is safe. Proceed through it while A2 inspects.

A4: Round 1: Gate 1 is known safe on the right. I should communicate this and advance through it.
Round 2: Gate 2 left is confirmed by A1/A2/A3. Gate 3 right is known safe to me. I can safely advance through both this round.
Round 3: At gate 4 with no known safe door. Inspect gate 4 and ask the team for confirmation before attempting it.
